Cheesey Baked Spaghetti Squash
By: Scout Mom
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 4:56pm

Ingredients




1 large Spaghetti Squash
1 Jar of Ragu Spaghetti Sauce ( I used SCMushroom)
1 pound Lean Ground meat or ground turkey
Cheese what ever you want how much you want

Preparation

1 Slice squash in half long length and scrap out seeds place meat side down in microwave safe dish and pour 1/4 cup water in dish cover with plastic wrap and cook 7 to 10 min or until tender. 2 While squash is cooking  cook ground meat drain fat add spaghetti sauce mix well. 3 When squash is done remove with fork it should just scrap out and look like spaghetti. Put squash in 13x9 baking dish. Add meat sauce on top of squash then cover with cheese. 4 Bake in 350 oven until cheese melts and is hot all the way thru.
